claim: deep-research produces a 17-section research.md synthesis plus resource-map and treats ruled-out directions as first-class output; its convergence report carries metrics, not content.
deep-review produces a nine-section report with P0/P1/P2 severities and a fixed PASS/CONDITIONAL/FAIL verdict, and its completion display reduces that to counts plus a token.
deep-ai-council hands recommendations and risk analysis to implementation and converges on adjudicator-verdict stability, so its presentation owes the direction, the agreement level and the dissent.
deep-agent-improvement produces packet-local candidates with 5-dimension scores and a stopReason/sessionOutcome pair, and its completion display reports scores only.

deep-model-benchmark produces fixture scores, an aggregate and a scoringMethod against a profile, and it is the only mode whose display instructions name a recommendation field (continue/promote/stop).

deep-skill-benchmark emits a ranked diagnostic report whose actionable content is the ranked bottlenecks, and its presentation boundary forbids the router from synthesizing verdicts, scores or bottlenecks.

The correct cross-mode obligation is the synthesized conclusion plus the smallest set of specifics that changes the reader's next action, with the artifact path for provenance, not a generic recommendations section.

answer: Six distinct rows: findings (research), findings plus remediation (review), recommendations proper with dissent (council), candidate plus promotion recommendation (agent improvement), scores plus a benchmark verdict (model benchmark), verdict plus ranked bottlenecks (skill benchmark). One generic answer would misfile four modes.

approach: A single generic 'present the recommendations' shape across all six modes
reason: Model benchmark and skill benchmark do not produce recommendation-shaped output; each mode's artifact dictates a different presentation
